capabilities: Import Kindle My Clippings.txt and Kindle notebook HTML
Import KOReader metadata sidecars and JSON exports
Create one note per book with a block ID per highlight
Skip already-imported highlights and merge exact repeats on re-import
extras: Kindle imports are free; Kobo and KOReader imports need a one-time US$12 Pro license, not sold in Japan. Importing never uses the network, but activating or removing a Pro key contacts Polar. The README notes no testing on physical devices and mobile was checked only in desktop emulation.
problem: Ebook highlight exports arrive as flat files, and re-importing them into Obsidian tends to duplicate quotes or overwrite notes you have already edited.
